email.subject: Congratulations on Ovilla at Legacy Square — Let's Get Your Dallas Team on PerformanceHQ
email.body:
Hi [VP of Training and Development],

Congratulations on Fogelman's ninth Texas acquisition! We're excited to support your Dallas expansion. 

Let's get Ovilla's team set up on PerformanceHQ right away. We'll build a turnkey Capture Wizard training library using your proven playbooks—no rebuild needed. We can also have Mystery Shopping live within 60 days of opening to keep leasing and service quality aligned from day one.

Looking forward to supporting your growth.

Best,
[Account Manager]

email.subject: Congratulations on Gilbert – let's get the team trained and compliant from day one
email.body:
Hi [Learning Technologies Specialist] and [Director of Learning Innovation],

Congratulations on the Gilbert acquisition. We're excited to support the new team's onboarding.

Since your PerformanceHQ upgrade in November, you've realized real gains—managers now have real-time compliance visibility, and group-based assignments have lifted completion rates across your communities. We'd like to bring the Gilbert team into that same experience.

We'd like to help with: (1) a training-needs assessment for the new management and leasing staff, (2) location-specific Learning Plans tailored to Gilbert's team and compliance calendar, and (3) a briefing on the compliance-tracking benefits you're already seeing.

Let's connect early next week to confirm your go-live timeline and the best way to onboard them smoothly.

Best,
[Account Manager]

a_1eruma7.signalTitle: New student housing development (San Diego market)
a_1eruma7.goal: Expand Grace Hill's footprint into Akara's new San Diego student housing asset by launching Training and Policies for leasing and maintenance teams, and establish Mystery Shopping to protect tour quality and conversion.

stages.title: Validate
tasks: Log signal as account activity: 'Akara expansion—new 305-bed student housing property, San Diego; onboarding opportunity for Training, Policies, Mystery Shopping.' Category: expansion. Next-step date: Day 3.

Confirm account context: Virtual Tools (Realync) active across 1,000+ beds; known ROI on work-order reduction and tour conversion. Renewal date and contract term on file. Check for any service or support issues at current properties that may affect new property launch.
Identify Akara's student housing team structure (leasing, maintenance, ops leads) and onboarding timeline for San Diego property launch.

stages.title: Align internally
tasks: Brief Customer Success: gather insights on Realync usage at Kenect Nashville and Sora (Phoenix), user adoption rates, maintenance team's self-service comfort level, and any outstanding support needs. Ask for early wins and pain points that Training or Policies could address.

Confirm Account Manager leads the expansion play (no Sales involvement needed for this scope). If student housing strategy signals multi-year, portfolio-wide Training or Policies rollout, notify Director, Account Management for green light.

stages.title: Engage the customer
tasks: Reach [Director of Leasing and Marketing] with message focused on the new San Diego property launch: congratulate on the expansion, acknowledge the full-team onboarding need, and offer a brief conversation about how Training (Learning Plans for student-facing leasing) and Policies (resident self-service FAQs for maintenance) can accelerate ramp and reduce support overhead during construction and pre-opening.

stages.title: Act
tasks: Propose a phased onboarding plan: (1) Training Learning Plans for leasing team (tour skill, student housing objection handling) live before opening; (2) Policies hub for maintenance (appliance, HVAC, GFI FAQs) go-live with first resident move-in; (3) Mystery Shopping for leasing team's tour quality during pre-opening tours and first 90 days to validate conversion rates in student housing segment.

Present package as a multi-year contract option (e.g., 2-3 years covering this property plus future San Diego or student housing assets, with expanded seat pricing) alongside an annual option for this single property. Lead with the multi-year option and highlight the portfolio expansion value and training velocity gains.

stages.title: Track & close the loop
tasks: Log proposal in CRM: expansion opportunity, multi-year term sought, close date aligned with property opening timeline. Forecast category: expansion. Success measure: Training rollout complete before opening; Policies live within 30 days of first resident move-in; Mystery Shopping baseline scorecard delivered.

Close the loop with [Director of Leasing and Marketing] and Customer Success Manager on signed contract, assigned seats, and onboarding start date. Establish monthly check-ins through opening and first 90 days to track tour conversion, work-order self-service adoption, and expansion roadmap for other student housing or San Diego properties.

email.subject: Congratulations on Akara's San Diego student housing launch—let's get your team ready
email.body:
Hi [Director of Leasing and Marketing],

Congratulations on securing and closing the San Diego State student housing development. A 305-bed Class A asset is a great win, and we know full-team onboarding—especially during construction—is critical.

We'd like to help you accelerate ramp for leasing and maintenance. Your Realync success on tour conversion and work-order reduction at Kenect and Sora is a proven playbook. For this property, we're thinking Training (Learning Plans for student-facing tour skills) and Policies (self-service FAQs for maintenance common requests) to cut support overhead early, plus Mystery Shopping to validate leasing tour quality in student housing.

Would you have 20 minutes next week to explore how this can work for San Diego?

Thanks,
[Account Manager]
